subject: EdgeForge marketplace readiness: demo routing, sell-with entitlements & evidence runway
messages:
From: Liam Owens <liam@edgeforge.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2029-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: EdgeForge - marketplace listing & co-sell readiness

Hi Soojin and Ben,

Thanks for the call earlier today — excited to get EdgeForge into the marketplaces with a sell-with cadence. To help scope what we need from Redwood, I’m attaching a one-pager that covers the solution footprint and expected SKUs. High-level asks from our side:

- Private listing (GCP) + co-sell tagging (AWS & Azure) — we need entitlement guidance and any required reseller agreements
- A clear evidence pack (SOC2, data flow diagrams, routing controls) we can send to our procurement/legal
- Demo routing: when customers request an integrated demo, we want to ensure the customer sees a live Redwood-hosted flow + EdgeForge demo — need a recommended routing plan

Ideal timeline: we’re aiming to be live for a joint pilot the week of 2029-09-16. Is a two-week evidence sprint + tech wire-up realistic?

Attachments: EdgeForge_Solution_OnePager.pdf (1 page)

Thanks — if you can point us to the right internal owners for each bullet that’d be great. I’ve cc’d procurement (procurements@edgeforge.ai) in case we need to parallelize legal asks.

Best,
Liam Owens
Head of Partnerships, EdgeForge
liam@edgeforge.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Liam Owens <liam@edgeforge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-08-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeForge - marketplace listing & co-sell readiness

Liam — thanks for the one-pager and for laying out the timeline. Proposed approach from Redwood:

1) Evidence sprint (5 business days) — we’ll assemble a minimal evidence binder: SOC2 summary, data flow sketch, IP/tenant isolation notes, audit-log samples. Vivek will coordinate with Security to flag anything beyond the standard bundle.
2) Entitlement & SKU mapping — Ben will run through SKU gating and billing mapping; if you can share expected usage profiles that helps.
3) Demo routing & sell-with wire-up — recommend a small demo routing plan: Redwood-hosted API proxy for the joint demo + a shared demo runbook. We can give you two demo slots (pre-recorded + live) for the pilot week.

I’m looping in Vivek and Ben to own the evidence and SKU sides respectively. Can you confirm the pilot dates are flexible around 9/16-9/20 in case we need to shift? Also please share the SOC2 summary (if available) and any preferred Jira/drive links for artifact exchange.

Drive template for evidence binder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcd-EdgeForge-Evidence

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Liam Owens <liam@edgeforge.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-08-21T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeForge - marketplace listing & co-sell readiness

Looping in a quick SKU / billing note. Per our marketplace playbook: if EdgeForge wants co-sell entitlement across AWS/GCP/Azure we need to pick one canonical SKU that maps to each cloud's listing and provide an entitlement translation table. I attached a small template I use (sku-mapping-template.csv).

Ask from my side: please populate expected monthly active units and an estimate of peak TPS for the demo and pilot. We’ll need that to size reserved capacity for the demo routing and produce a cost estimate for pilot support.

Attachment: sku-mapping-template.csv (CSV, 1 sheet)

Ben
Head, Ecosystem Partnerships
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Liam Owens <liam@edgeforge.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@edgeforge.ai, Sana Patel <patel@edgeforge.ai>
Date: 2029-08-24T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeForge - marketplace listing & co-sell readiness

Thanks — attached is our SOC2 executive summary and an excerpt of our architecture (SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf). Procurement and legal want the evidence in a binder format; Sana (cc’d) will be the primary legal contact for contract/DocuSign. A couple of clarifications:

- We can provide expected MAUs and TPS estimates by tomorrow (will add to your template).
- We prefer private listing on GCP for the pilot and co-sell flags on AWS; Azure can follow in the second phase.
- DocuSign: we have a short co-marketing MOU we can sign to enable jointlanding pages and a case study. Link: https://docusign.com/12345-co-marketing-mou

Procurement note (procurements@edgeforge.ai): we’d appreciate a hardened evidence binder and a contact person for a possible security call.

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf (3 pages)

—

Date: 2029-08-28T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeForge - marketplace listing & co-sell readiness (Sprint plan + owners)

Team — I pulled the asks together into a short sprint runway so we can hit the pilot window. Summary and owners below: 

Sprint window: 2029-09-02 to 2029-09-06 (evidence sprint)
Pilot target: 2029-09-16 to 2029-09-20

Action items:
- Evidence binder (Vivek) — collate SOC2 summary, data-flow diagram, audit log sample; upload to Evidence Drive by EOD 9/4. (See Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcd-EdgeForge-Evidence)
- SKU mapping & entitlement table (Ben) — Ben to return completed sku-mapping-template.csv with MAU/TPS filled by 9/3.
- Demo routing & runbook (Soojin) — I will produce the demo runbook and Redwood-hosted proxy wiring notes; draft by 9/6 and share two demo slots for pilot week.
- Legal/DocuSign (Ben + Soojin) — prepare minimal co-marketing MOU and routing of DocuSign link to EdgeForge legal; target signature by 9/10. DocuSign: https://docusign.com/12345-co-marketing-mou

Procurement (Liam & procurements@edgeforge.ai): please confirm the GCP private listing scope and share any required billing/legal templates for private offers.

We’ll track this in HubSpot under deal EF-2029-47 and I’ll open a shared Jira ticket if we need engineering work beyond the runbook. If anything is blocking the schedule please flag immediately.

Thanks all —
Soojin Lee
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
